{{Quote|Thanks t'you, pilot, the Bright Jewel Ribbon be quiet as a purring gurrcat.|[[Aleas Rans'ery]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:CA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Counter Attack|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
The '''Bright Jewel Ribbon''' was a quadrant of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. It was located between the [[Lucent Ivaya]] and the [[Scarlet Dawn]] quadrants.<ref name="SWG:PBJR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Patrol: Bright Jewel Ribbon|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Aleas Rans'ery handles anything that deals with the Bright Jewel Ribbon Quadrant. It concerns the defensive assignments for our pilots.|[[Laetin A'shera]], to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:AtA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Assassinating the Assassin|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Aleas Rans'ery]] oversaw all [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] operations in the Bright Jewel Ribbon quadrant. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]] between Car'das and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] forces, Rans'ery dispatched pilots to attacks Black Sun ships in the area.<ref name="SWG:PBJR" /> Her pilots also rescued the Kallor brothers [[Sulale Kallor|Sulale]] and [[Waris Kallor|Waris]] from a Black Sun ambush,<ref name="SWG:KBR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Kallor Brothers Rescue|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> as well as [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]] [[Atris (officer)|Atris]] of the [[Dynath Miners]].<ref name="SWG:BSA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Black Sun Attacks|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> Car'das pilots eventually eliminated the [[Ace/Legends|ace]] and Black Sun hero [[Arlem Demonhunter]] in the Bright Jewel Ribbon.<ref name="SWG:CA" />
